title: Cohomology is unchanged by pushforward along a closed immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to X be a continuous map that is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of X, and let F be an abelian sheaf on Z. Define (i_*F)(U)=F(i^{-1}U) for each open U of X. For every integer p>=0, there is a natural isomorphism H^p(Z,F) \cong H^p(X,i_*F), where cohomology is [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: The direct image functor for the closed immersion is the direct image for the inclusion of the closed subset i(Z), and it is exact on abelian sheaves by [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact]. Thus every short exact sequence on Z remains short exact after applying i_*.

source.place: Lemma 02UV proof, first sentence: exactness of i_* from Modules Lemma 01AX

proof.text: The categories Ab(Z) and Ab(X) of abelian sheaves (sheaves on the sites of open subsets with open coverings) are abelian with enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives], and i_* is additive since (i_*F)(U)=F(i^{-1}U) is additive in F. Apply [lem-sc-exact-functor-higher-derived-vanishing] to the exact additive functor i_*:Ab(Z)\to Ab(X) from Step 1. Its right derived functors satisfy R^q i_* F=0 for every q>0.

source.place: Lemma 02UV proof, first sentence: exactness gives R^p i_*=0

proof.text: The Leray comparison [lem-sc-leray-closed-pushforward-cohomology], applied to f=i and the vanishing in Step 2, gives a natural isomorphism H^p(Z,F)\cong H^p(X,i_*F) for every p>=0. The direct image is the sheaf defined by (i_*F)(U)=F(i^{-1}U), which is the formula in the statement.
